# Use section classes for shared contact display and print templates

_fillContactDetails queries a section class and then ul.entry-list, rather than any ul below a container. Both visible contact and print templates repeat the .details-* section classes and entry-list/entry-item/entry-value forms. Recommend maintaining those dashed class roles across both consumers when adding a contact section. CamelCase DOM IDs remain a separate existing namespace; this is not a rule to rename every address-book ID. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/components/addrbook.
